## Current evidence — installed terms complete; release-note linkage is M7.P5

D-WORKFLOW-131 fixes the artwork grant and trademark policy; D-WORKFLOW-136/144 carry the later Blitterbot/pixelelated names. The current `LICENSE.md` and `TRADEMARK.md` are present in accepted candidate16's installed `/usr/share/licenses/pixelelated/` on both clean and actual RC2-upgraded guests. The retained QA20 receipts report PASS on `ee014909137e03706e0b3020b8396be589aaa705` and exact file hashes:

| File | SHA256 |
| --- | --- |
| `LICENSE.md` | `1a277de267611abc4242e6a1e08ac2abac54316e7abcbf8ae7afd0a1dc98ec6c` |
| `TRADEMARK.md` | `d46db25cb845b021cd7f1c13dabcd98d04e77d89a45968527e58abc9e3788761` |

Both hashes independently match the current files and those files at candidate16's frozen commit. Primary receipts: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-pixelelated-replacement-16/qa-20/artifacts/payload-clean.json`, `payload-upgrade.json` and `qa-20/owner-verification.json`; the same accepted QA20 run records the vocabulary suite PASS in `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-07-pixelelated-replacement-16/qa20-acceptance/acceptance.json`. No VM or device proof was replayed for this reconciliation.

The installed-terms criterion is checked. Current placement is M7.P5 because the sole remaining criterion is release-note linkage under #344; the earlier P3 installed proof remains accepted. The release-note lineage/non-endorsement link remains open; this does not complete the component inventory, corresponding-source bundle, public documentation or release publication. Original questions and dated implementation narrative below remain historical.

## Historical identity transition — 2026-10-04

#409 is first within M7.P3 before the next freeze/build: lowercase **pixelelated**, organization `pixelelated`, owner `rasteratops`, unchanged developer `blitterbot`, default `/pixelelated`. Rasteratops remains a character. D-WORKFLOW-144/D-CLOUD-174 supersede earlier project/default naming below. The owner confirms no systems use `/Rasteratops`: **ROCKNIX → pixelelated** is the required adoption path. Existing cloud folders may move through the established verified migration. Historical replacement02 remains RASTERATOPS evidence; new bytes require new qualification. The milestone body owns the order, followed by remaining P3 checks, expanded P4 fixes audit and separately gated P5.

## The maintainer's words (2026-10-01)

> What is CC BY-NC-SA? I assume it's non-commercial, share-alike, but can you specify? What can I do to control the brand if I want, if at all?

## Today

`LICENSE.md:9-11` licenses *ROCKNIX's* branding and images under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the fork replaces that branding (D-WORKFLOW-084) and must say what its own name and artwork are offered under. The code stays GPL-2 (`LICENSE.md` § ROCKNIX Software), which governs the software, not the name. The interim icon is `docs/rasteratops/art/icon-interim-2026-10-01.png`.

## The choices (not legal advice; the decision is the maintainer's)

- **Artwork licence**: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (the terms the fork itself accepted from ROCKNIX; a downstream fork would owe the same), CC BY-ND 4.0 (copies allowed, no adaptations), or all rights reserved (the art may not be copied at all, which every clone of a public repository technically does).
- **The name and mark**: a written trademark policy (`TRADEMARK.md`): the name and logo identify this project's own builds; unmodified builds may carry them; a modified build is renamed; no endorsement implied. Copyright on the art does not do this job; a trademark, registered or by use, does. Registration (USPTO, class 9) is a later, optional step if the project ever faces the public.

## Historical implementation status — 2026-10-02

D-WORKFLOW-131 chose the artwork grant and trademark policy; D-WORKFLOW-136 renames only the bot mark to **Blitterbot**. The pending identity branch’s `TRADEMARK.md` and `LICENSE.md` name Rasteratops, Blitterbot and the logo (#374). The original terms discussion and quotations above/below remain historical; image/release verification is still required by this issue.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] A register row records the artwork licence and whether a trademark policy exists; `LICENSE.md`'s branding section names the fork's terms and `TRADEMARK.md` exists or the row says why not (`tools/vocabulary-check` and the licence text in the image's `/usr/share/licenses` agree: a `grep` on the image's SYSTEM).
- [ ] The release notes' lineage and non-endorsement paragraph (#344 P4) points at the same terms.
